name: Ghost Bars
description: Bars in tubes with the previous period as a thin ghost bar beside each and the current period outlined in ink.

props.name: data
props.description: This period's values, as water filling the tubes.

props.name: previous
props.description: The previous period's values, as thin ghost bars beside each tube.

props.name: currentIndex
props.description: The period in progress, outlined in ink. Pass -1 for none.

props.name: currentName
props.description: Name of this period in the legend and tooltip.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes values in the tooltip. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: formatAxis
props.description: Writes the tick labels on the left. Defaults to compact numbers.

props.name: titles
props.description: Longer names for the tooltip title.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show a legend under the plot.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: A title under the horizontal axis. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: A title beside the vertical axis, set sideways. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change as a signed fraction, shown as a chip beside the value.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts caption, note, action, footer, invertDelta and every other prop of a div.
